BrochureContent.Content:
Castlethorn are delighted to introduce The Spinnaker, The Moorings and The Dunmore at South Coast, Woodbrook. These three boutique apartment buildings are situated in the heart of the landmark Woodbrook development. Comprising just 24, 17 & 32 apartments respectively, these elegant buildings offer a selection of spacious 1,2 and 3-bedroom apartments over four or five storeys. All of the apartments have excellent outside space with usable balconies or terraces. 

The apartments at South Coast are highly efficient and exceptionally well insulated making them extremely warm and comfortable to live in. A large bicycle store is provided, and each building has a lift serving all floors. They are spacious and particularly bright and the 2-bedroom apartments are all dual aspect. Typical of Castlethorn's quality and reputation, they are beautifully equipped and built to the highest standards.

A major highlight is the brand-new DART station now open in Woodbrook, offering transformative connectivity to the city and surrounding coastal suburbs. This makes South Coast at Woodbrook an ideal location for commuters and families alike.

As part of the overall masterplan, Woodbrook will also include a school, crèche, and a neighbourhood centre, ensuring a well-rounded, community-focused lifestyle. Residents will enjoy easy access to local amenities including beaches at Shankill, Bray, and Killiney, along with a selection of excellent schools and top-tier shopping.

Located in the northern part of the development, South Coast is laid out in a series of charming, well-planned streets. A diverse range of homes is available. 

All homes in Woodbrook are built to Castlethorn's renowned high standards, with an A-rating for energy efficiency and contemporary finishes throughout.

Families will benefit from proximity to leading primary and secondary schools, including Woodbrook College, Scoil Mhuire, St. Gerard's, Presentation College, St. Killian's, and Loreto Secondary School. Nearby Shankill Village provides everyday conveniences, while Carrickmines Retail Park and Dundrum Town Centre offer premium shopping options, both easily reached by car.

To find out more or to register your interest, visit www.south-coast.ie or contact Sherry FitzGerald New Homes at +353 1 667 1888.

Upon registering your details will be passed to Castlethorn and Sherry FitzGerald
